instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a grassy outdoor park with trees in the background. The bald man in the dark blue t-shirt (R2) stands on the left, holding a framed certificate and smiling excitedly with his mouth open. Next to him, the woman with the large afro (R6), wearing a red t-shirt and blue jeans, stands on the right, smiling warmly at the camera while holding her own framed certificate. They pose side-by-side, celebrating their achievements in warm, natural daylight with soft shadows.
